name: Exp_ColorZerolagRVI
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorZerolagRVI indicator, a zero-lag composite RVI (Relative Vigor Index) oscillator built from five weighted RVI components. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Trade execution is restricted to new bar formation to avoid redundant signals within the same candle.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagRVI指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标是由五个加权RVI分量合成的零滞后相对活力指数振荡器。当主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并设有可配置的止损止盈水平。交易执行仅在新K线形成时触发，以避免同一K线内重复信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用ColorZerolagRVI指标作为核心策略信号源，该指标通过将五个不同周期(8,21,34,55,89)的RVI以特定权重(0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43)加权合成，消除传统RVI的滞后性。入场条件为：当前K线的Osc1(主线)与Osc2(信号线)处于同侧且前一根K线发生交叉穿越——具体而言，当Osc1[1]>Osc2[1]（主线在信号线上方）且Osc1[0]<Osc2[0]（前一根K线主线在信号线下方）时产生买入信号，表示主线刚从下方穿越信号线。出场条件包括止损和止盈（以点数设置）以及反向交叉信号平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数大小，支持固定手数和基于保证金的两种模式。资金管理方面提供了止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认设置，盈亏比为1:2。信号只在每根新K线形成时计算一次，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the ColorZerolagRVI indicator as its core signal source, which synthesizes five RVI components with different periods (8, 21, 34, 55, 89) using specific weights (0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43) to eliminate the lag inherent in traditional RVI. Entry conditions require that the current bar's main line (Osc1) and signal line (Osc2) are on the same side while the previous bar showed a crossover — specifically, a buy signal occurs when Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] and Osc1[0]<Osc2[0], indicating the main line just crossed above the signal line. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit (set in points) and closing positions on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and margin-based lot calculation modes via the MMMode input. Money management defaults to a 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. Signal calculation is restricted to new bar formation only, preventing redundant trades within the same candle.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制手数大小或保证金比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：固定手数或基于保证金
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于判断信号的K线索引

pros: 使用零滞后RVI合成指标，减少了传统RVI的延迟问题，信号更及时
新K线检查机制避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
提供了开关控制买入/卖出的开仓和平仓，灵活性高，可单独测试多空方向
默认1:2的盈亏比设计合理，有利于长期正期望值
多周期RVI加权合成(8-89周期)，兼顾短中长周期的动量信息
pros_en: Uses a zero-lag composite RVI indicator that reduces the delay problem of traditional RVI, providing more timely signals
New bar check mechanism prevents redundant trade entries within the same candle, reducing overtrading risk
Provides independent toggle switches for buy/sell open and close operations, offering high flexibility for directional testing
Default 1:2 risk-reward ratio is well-designed, favorable for long-term positive expectancy
Multi-period weighted RVI synthesis (8-89 periods) captures momentum information across short, medium, and long timeframes
cons: 没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致同方向重复开仓增加风险敞口
止损止盈使用固定点数而非基于ATR等动态指标，在不同波动率环境下效果差异大
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能在信号产生时已被点差吞噬利润
依赖自定义指标ColorZerolagRVI，如果指标文件缺失则EA无法初始化
Recount标志在CopyBuffer失败时设为true但无重试次数限制，可能在数据缺失时频繁重试
cons_en: No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to repeated entries and increased risk exposure
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed point values instead of dynamic indicators like ATR, performing inconsistently across varying volatility environments
No spread filter mechanism; in high-spread environments, profits may be consumed by spread costs when signals trigger
Depends on the custom ColorZerolagRVI indicator file; if missing, the EA fails to initialize
The Recount flag is set to true on CopyBuffer failure without a retry limit, potentially causing frequent retries during data gaps
improvements: 增加同方向持仓检查，避免重复开仓；或增加最大持仓数量限制参数
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算方式，适应不同市场波动率环境
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免高点差时段和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add same-direction position check to prevent repeated entries, or add a maximum position count parameter
Change stop-loss and take-profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatility environments
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 缺乏同方向重复持仓检查，可能在趋势行情中不断加仓导致风险敞口过大
固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过大高波动时止损过小
无点差过滤和交易时段控制，可能在不利条件下执行交易
risk_points_en: Lack of same-direction position check may lead to continuous position stacking during trending markets, causing excessive risk exposure
Fixed-point stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility changes; stop-loss may be too wide in low volatility or too tight in high volatility
No spread filter or trading session control may result in trade execution under unfavorable conditions
